en_title: Gorakhpur Development Authority Inspects Chhath Ghats and Ramgarh Tal Cleaning
en_seo_title: Gorakhpur Development Authority Inspects Chhath Ghats and Ramgarh Tal Cleaning
en_body: The Gorakhpur Development Authority has reviewed Chhath Puja preparations at several public sites, including the Ramgarh Tal area. GDA Vice-Chairman Abhinav Gopal inspected ghats with other officials on November 12, according to reporting published the following day. The inspection focused on sanitation, lighting, drinking water and visitor safety. Officials were directed to extend machinery operating hours and add workers to remove water hyacinth from Ramgarh Tal. They also discussed steps to address unpleasant odours around the water. Special teams were assigned to monitor arrangements at seven locations in the Taramandal area, including areas near Nauka Vihar, Champa Devi Park and the Tal Ring Road. These are instructions and preparations reported by the authority; their full completion has not been independently verified. The measures are intended to improve conditions for festival visitors.
